title: A battle sprite's rig
description: One side (front or back) of a battle sprite's MCSS rig as tools/paperwhite2/mcss_rig.py reads and writes it: the five files <side>_info.bin, _cells.ncer, _animations.nanr.lz11, _multi_cells.nmcr and _multi_animations.nmar, drawn from the side's 256 by 128 sheet. docs/paperwhite2/design/battle-sprites.md section 15. Fields marked 'only where a file differs' are left out when they hold the usual value, which the writer puts back.

play.description: NNSG2dAnimationPlayMode: play once and hold the last key, loop, or forward then back

frames.description: How many game frames (60 a second) the key lasts; the game holds a key, never tweens

rotation.description: srt keys: the turn, in 65536ths of a full turn

scale.description: srt keys: the x and y scale (1 is the picture's size; negative mirrors), multiples of 1/4096

move.description: srt and move keys: the move in pixels, x right, y down

unused.description: move keys: the result's unused half-word, only where a file differs from 0xBEEF

marker.description: The frame's marker, only where a file differs from 0xBEEF

result_copy.description: Which copy of an equal result the key points at, only in the 7 originals that hold second copies

box.description: The sprite's box (MCSS_GetHeight, MCSS_GetOffsetY), which the egg hatching and evolution centre by

stop_flags.description: Read only by the move effects' scripts (MCSSSys_GetStopCellFlags); 1 for 166 flying or floating species' fronts, inferred to mean airborne

idle_parts.description: The parts (by their place in the pose, 0 the front) that keep animating while the battle's idle pause stops the rest; null for a sprite that never pauses

info_padding.description: The bin's bytes after the idle parts, as hex, only where a file differs from zeros to the next multiple of 4

obj_mapping.description: The NCER's OBJ mapping mode, only where a file differs from 4

extension.description: The NCER's and NANR's UEXT word, only where a file differs from 1

picture_labels.description: The NCER's LABL names, only where they differ from the tracks' names

pictures.description: The cells: what a part can show

rectangles.description: The bin's quads: rectangles of the sheet, the second drawn in front of the first

sheet.description: The rectangle's top left on the sheet, in pixels

size.description: Its width and height in pixels (0 in a first rectangle: nothing drawn)

at.description: Where its top left goes from the part's pivot, in pixels, x right, y up; multiples of 1/256

objs.description: The NCER's OBJs, which MCSS doesn't draw; mcss_rig.generate_objs makes them from the rectangles

attributes.description: The rest of the three OBJ attributes (affine, double size, mode, palette...)

obj_attribute.description: The NCER cell's attribute (its low bits a bounding radius, inferred)

tracks.description: The cell animations: a part's keys

name.description: The label, which names the part (head_a: the head in pose a)

key_type.description: What each key holds besides its picture: nothing, a rotation, scale and move, or a move

loop_start.description: Only where a file differs from 0

bank_type.description: Only where a file differs from 1

poses.description: The multi-cells: the whole Pokémon as parts

instances.description: How many track instances the pose's parts use, only where a file differs from one per part

parts.description: The nodes, front to back (the layer order)

pivot.description: Where the part turns and scales about, from the feet, in pixels, x right, y down

play.description: Whether the track restarts when the pose starts, or goes on from the sequence's time

instance.description: The track instance, only where a file differs from the part's place

flags.description: The node attribute's bits 4 to 7, only where a file differs from 0x20

sequences.description: The multi-cell animations: 0 the loop the battle plays (stay), 1 the idle pause's pose (stop)

key_type.description: What each key holds besides its pose: nothing, a rotation, scale and move of the whole sprite, or a move

loop_start.description: Only where a file differs from 0

bank_type.description: Only where a file differs from 2
